messages:
sam: dropping a short review thread for the key-management revamp. Main items: rotate modal wording, archive vs revoke language, undo patterns, and keyboard/AX flow. mock: https://design.redwood.ai/keylist-revamp-v2.png
kevin: quick take 
kevin: whoops stray chars. re-sending: I think 'Archive (recoverable)' is friendlier than 'Revoke' but could be unclear. We should label recovery window (14 days?) inline.
mia: AX: when a secret is shown after rotate, announce with aria-live="polite" and avoid autofocus. Reveal button must be keyboard focusable and include aria-label like 'Reveal secret for key project-x'.
alex: Frontend: modal will trap focus; rotate flow shows one-time secret with copy + download. We'll emit analytics: key.rotate.preview_shown. For SSO-managed keys, hide rotate and show tooltip 'Managed by identity provider'.
jen: Copy suggestion for rotate modal title: 'Rotate API key'. Body: 'A new secret will be generated and shown only once. Update services before archiving the old key.' CTA primary: 'Rotate and show secret'. Secondary: 'Cancel'. Add optional checkbox 'I will update integrations' to enable the CTA.
sam: For archive vs delete: archive = recoverable amber state (14 days); delete = 'Delete forever' destructive flow with confirmation and a typed input. In-row microcopy: 'Archived 3 days left' and in details show 'Archived by @sam on Mar 3'.
kevin: Empty state copy: headline 'No API keys yet' with two CTAs: 'Create your first key' and 'Explore example integrations'. Hint: 'Use least-privilege scopes and rotate regularly.'
mia: Empty state AX: primary CTA should have aria-label 'Create a new API key'. Provide an off-screen skip link to 'Explore example integrations' for screen reader users.
alex: Keyboard flow: single tabbable element per row (checkbox or primary action). Overflow menu accessible by Enter/Space and arrow keys. Menu items should include context like 'Archive key project-x (recoverable)'.
jen: Undo pattern: use a polite live region: role="status" aria-live="polite" with message 'Key archived. Undo available.' Also include a persistent 'Recover' action in the key details panel. Toast should allow Esc to dismiss.
sam: Scopes display: compact rows show up to 2 scope pills + '+n' indicator. Tooltip on hover; for keyboard expose 'Show scopes' in overflow.
designbot: mock uploaded to /assets/keylist-rotate-archive-v3.png (sha256:beefcafe)
kevin: plan: A/B test 'Archive (recoverable)' vs 'Disable (recoverable)' and measure how often users proceed to delete. jen will draft modal copy variants; mia will prepare SR strings; alex prototypes keyboard flows. sam to confirm retention window with security. Thanks.
